name: week
title: Innovation review
subtitle: Triage, review gaps and overdue pilots

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention_items order by due_date,kind,item

sections.title: Review coverage
sections.sql: select campaign,name,criteria,covered,complete_reviewers,weighted_score from idea_scores order by campaign,name

name: outcomes
title: Commitments and measured outcomes
subtitle: Only independently verified outcomes are counted; currencies stay separate

sections.title: Campaign budget
sections.sql: select name,currency,budget,committed,verified_outcomes from campaign_summary order by name

sections.title: Pilot results
sections.sql: select name,metric,baseline,target,actual,status,evidence from pilots order by name
